title: Lilac flower tea - summer cottage
en: making lilac tea is a treat that I look forward to all year i watch with anticipation waiting for when the blooms are just ready for harvesting we have an abundance of herbs and flowers available to us that can be made into delicious tea you can usually grow your own herbs and flowers from seed but you can also purchase them at your local nursery

separating the sweet blossoms from the more bitter stems is a time-consuming process I often think of it as a sort of labor a meditation in teaching me how to be patient and thoughtful and in the present after the tea is brewed for a few minutes I usually add something to give the cup a little bit of sweetness the first sip of tea is always the most

satisfying I love the taste and smell it is always worth the effort to put love and patience into everything you do the end result is that much better of course there's nothing like a freshly brewed cup of tea to inspire your creativity I always find myself painting with a cup next to my hand I'll see you guys next time I upload videos every
Wednesday if you enjoyed this consider subscribing thank you
zh: 制作紫丁香茶是我全年都期待的一种享受，我满怀期待地等待着花朵刚刚准备好收获的时候，我们有大量的香草和鲜花可供我们使用，可以制成美味的茶，您通常可以从种子中种植自己的香草和鲜花，但您也可以在当地的苗圃购买它们
将甜花与更苦的茎分开是一个耗时的过程，我经常认为这是一种劳动，一种冥想，教我如何耐心和体贴，在茶泡几分钟后的当下，我通常会添加一些东西给杯子一点点甜味，第一口茶总是最好的
我喜欢它的味道和气味，总是值得付出努力，把爱和耐心投入到你所做的一切中，最终的结果是更好的当然，没有什么比一杯现泡的茶更能激发你的创造力了，我总是发现自己用手边的杯子画画，下次我上传视频时，我会见到你们
